title: fix: allow custom strings alongside tool parameter presets
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Tools that accept presets such as `"compact"` or `"wide"` alongside custom strings can reject `"customer-layout"` before execution because schema normalization retains only the presets.

## User Impact

Custom names reach the tool instead of failing local validation. Root unions remain flattened, so this does not enforce per-branch combinations.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep a plain string alternative when all of that property's normalized alternatives are string presets or plain strings. Root properties and other combinations keep the existing merge rules.

## Evidence

Live ChatGPT verification with a registered local stdio MCP server: all six model-issued tool calls reached execution and were saved/read back unchanged. This covers root `anyOf` and `oneOf` in both branch orders, plus preset and overlapping-value controls. Model responses and MCP transport were not mocked.

<details>
<summary>Captured Agent → MCP → file readback</summary>

```text
ChatGPT HTTP responses: 200, 200
Registered tool: layouts__layout_anyof_presets_first
Registered value schema: {"type":"string"}
Model tool arguments: {"action":"custom","value":"customer-layout"}
MCP tools/call received: {"action":"custom","value":"customer-layout"}
Original server schema valid: true
Saved file readback: {"action":"custom","value":"customer-layout"}
Final Agent reply: done (stop)
```

| Registered tool suffix | Model value | MCP value | File readback |
|---|---|---|---|
| `layout_anyof_presets_first` | `customer-layout` | `customer-layout` | `customer-layout` |
| `layout_oneof_presets_first` | `customer-layout` | `customer-layout` | `customer-layout` |
| `layout_anyof_custom_first` | `customer-layout` | `customer-layout` | `customer-layout` |
| `layout_oneof_custom_first` | `customer-layout` | `customer-layout` | `customer-layout` |
| `layout_preset_control` | `compact` | `compact` | `compact` |
| `layout_overlap_control` | `compact` | `compact` | `compact` |

The preset control used `action: "preset"`; the other five used `action: "custom"`. The local server validated each request against its original union schema before saving it.

</details>

162 focused and adjacent tests pass on the refreshed base. The normalization and MCP registration code used in the live trace above is unchanged.

<details>
<summary>Test cost</summary>

The single-worker run took 51.05 s, mostly runner setup and transforms. In [CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36472147415/job/109097544417), all 33 cases passed and their reported test times totaled 0.255 s, including 72 ms for the ten added cases. These direct normalizer/TypeBox checks protect whether valid strings reach tool execution; they add no processes, sleeps, or external calls.

</details>

Updated from main to include the catalog fixture's hydration wait. The original 15-file failing group passes locally: 211 tests passed, with one platform skip.
